sentence: This project tests a software tool that automatically keeps track of cancer patients in follow-up care so they are not lost.
This project builds tools that measure kinases in single cells of the mouse and human brain to study pathways involved in aging and Alzheimer’s Diseases.
This project upgrades an ultrasound imaging system to improve image quality for studying disease in preclinical models of cardiovascular biology and cancer biology.
This project studies how cytokinesis and the septin cytoskeleton work in cells and how defects in them cause diseases such as cancer.
This project develops methods that use electronic health records to find patients who have a medical condition but were never diagnosed.
This project studies drug induced liver injury, a serious problem that can lead to liver failure, through clinical, mechanistic and therapeutic research.
This project builds a platform to guide the evolution of base editors so they edit genes more precisely, for genetic diseases such as cystic fibrosis.
This project tries to find drug candidates that block a receptor's overactivity caused by a protein made by metastatic prostate cancer cells.
This project uses a fluorescent and bioluminescent virus to study how opioids affect HIV transcription and latency reversal in the central nervous system.
This project tests compounds that act on the liver as a treatment for hepatitis A virus infection.
This project engineers macrophages and microglia to express a Chimeric Antigen Receptor so they can act against glioblastoma brain tumors.
This project studies how molecules control ion channels involved in touch sensation and how this affects neurodevelopment and behavior.
This project develops machine learning methods that automatically standardize and improve metadata in biomedical databases.
This project builds tools that screen and validate existing drugs as candidates for treating Alzheimer’s Disease and Related Dementias.
This project looks for biomarkers that show which patients with hepatocellular carcinoma face adverse outcomes from immunotherapy and which benefit from it.
This project develops and tests an MRI method that measures tissue kinetic and flow parameters in the pancreas during free breathing.
This project studies how a group of host immune proteins protects Arabidopsis plants from infection.
This project tests whether activating a sirtuin and blocking a cell death protein helps stem cells and aged cartilage repair itself in aged animals.
This project studies how heterochromatin forms at human centromeres to silence repetitive sequences in the genome.
